result.card: Adds an evalscript subcommand to bitcoin-util to execute arbitrary script fragments using Bitcoin Core's consensus interpreter. This gives developers and researchers a CLI tool to inspect script behavior, script error codes, and final stack contents across various sigversions and verify flags without writing ad-hoc test code. It also supports transaction-contextual validation for opcodes like CHECKSIG, CSV, and CLTV when transaction data is supplied. The utility is intended as a debugging and development aid.
